findingsAddressed.title: full-test is permitted before the Delivery reaches authorized
findingsAddressed.rootCause: 083 restricted full-test eligibility to {awaiting-user-decision, authorized} but still included awaiting-user-decision, which is a pre-authorization state. Frozen verification-model.md Section 4.2 defines the state machine as awaiting-user-decision → authorized → passed|failed and states '未 authorized 时不得执行 Full Test'. Only authorized means the owner has explicitly authorized; awaiting-user-decision means the owner has NOT yet authorized. 083 misinterpreted D1-PR-005's requiredChange wording ('awaiting-user-decision or explicitly authorized, as appropriate to the action boundary') as meaning both states are eligible.
findingsAddressed.fix: Restricted full-test precondition to deliveryFullTestStatus = authorized ONLY. awaiting-user-decision → canRun(full-test) returns allowed:false + full-test-not-authorized; next returns owner-decision: authorize-full-test (when ownerAuthorizations has no full-test scope). Added new spec scenario 'full-test 在 awaiting-user-decision 时拒绝'. Updated D1-13 behavior matrix (awaiting-user-decision row: allowed:false → owner-decision). Added authorization transition model section documenting awaiting-user-decision → authorized triggered by owner authorization, C1 atomic update responsibility, D1 read-only view. Updated D1-12 complementarity reference. Updated 4.12/4.18/10.23. Updated conclusion (scratch) Section 3.2/3.3/5/9.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: spec.md full-test precondition: 'deliveryFullTestStatus = authorized' + frozen Section 4.2 quote '未 authorized 时不得执行 Full Test'. New scenario 'full-test 在 awaiting-user-decision 时拒绝': allowed:false + full-test-not-authorized + next owner-decision:authorize-full-test + MUST NOT action:full-test. design.md D1-13 matrix: awaiting-user-decision row = allowed:false + owner-decision:authorize-full-test. design.md authorization transition model: awaiting-user-decision→authorized by owner authorization, D1 treats deliveryFullTestStatus as authoritative. verification-model.md:117-119 Section 4.2: '只有 owner 明确授权后才能进入 authorized; 未 authorized 时不得执行 Full Test' — cited as frozen authority. No remaining {awaiting-user-decision, authorized} as full-test accepting condition (verified by grep).

keyFindings: D1-PR-006 is a content defect: 083 included awaiting-user-decision as a full-test eligible state, but frozen verification-model.md Section 4.2 line 118 states '未 authorized 时不得执行 Full Test'.
Frozen Section 4.2 line 117: '只有 owner 明确授权后才能进入 authorized' — awaiting-user-decision is explicitly the pre-authorization state.
full-test requires deliveryFullTestStatus = authorized (the ONLY state where Full Test can execute per frozen model).
awaiting-user-decision → owner-decision: authorize-full-test (owner needs to authorize, which transitions deliveryFullTestStatus to authorized).

authorized + ownerAuthorizations has full-test scope → action: full-test (normal path). authorized + no full-test scope → owner-decision: authorize-full-test (defensive fail-closed for inconsistent state).

D1-PR-005 (failed → blocked:full-test-failed), D1-PR-003/004 (081), D1-PR-001/002 (079) all remain resolved and unmodified.
